name: aicte-fdr-vault
description: AICTE FDR Vault - Transparent. Tracked. Timely.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && pnpm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.verify: cd backend && pnpm run build && pnpm test && cd ../frontend && pnpm run build && echo 'ALL VERIFY CHECKS PASSED'
scripts.build: cd backend && pnpm run build && cd ../frontend && pnpm run build
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:clean: cd backend && node -e "const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const p = new PrismaClient(); async function main() { await p.alertLog.deleteMany(); await p.releaseStep.deleteMany(); await p.releaseRequest.deleteMany(); await p.document.deleteMany(); await p.auditLog.deleteMany(); await p.fdr.deleteMany(); await p.notification.deleteMany(); await p.institution.deleteMany(); console.log('All institutions, FDRs, and transactional records cleaned successfully.'); } main().finally(() => p.\$disconnect());"
